# hetznerrobot_subnet_mac (Resource)

The MAC address an IPv6 subnet is routed to — one of the server's `possible_mac` addresses (see the `hetznerrobot_subnet_mac` data source). Destroying the resource resets it to the MAC of the server's main IP. IPv4 subnets do not support this (`MAC_NOT_AVAILABLE`). Limited to 10 changes per hour.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hetznerrobot_subnet_mac" "v6" {
  ip = "2a01:4f8:111:4221::"
}

# Routes the IPv6 subnet to the MAC of the additional IP instead of the
# server's main IP.
resource "hetznerrobot_subnet_mac" "v6" {
  ip  = data.hetznerrobot_subnet_mac.v6.ip
  mac = data.hetznerrobot_subnet_mac.v6.possible_mac["123.123.123.125"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip` (String) Net address of the subnet.
- `mac` (String) Target MAC address.

### Read-Only

- `mask` (String) Prefix length of the subnet.
- `possible_mac` (Map of String) MAC addresses the subnet can be routed to, keyed by IP address.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import hetznerrobot_subnet_mac.v6 2a01:4f8:111:4221::
```
